about: lease-sync's application mutants: the program forms of models/replica's mutants and the RPO1 rows; each is judged by the example's tests and laws (scripts/examples lease-sync), not by a compiler test. The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: rp1-resend-not-recognised
mutants.rule: A resend of a kept id is the first receipt and changes nothing: Authority.PushIsIdempotent for memory.Leases.

mutants.name: rp1-accepts-ahead
mutants.rule: A command past the client's next one is refused OutOfOrder and keeps nothing, so a client's log has no gap: Authority.AheadIsRefused, StateIsLogReplay, ProtocolHolds.

mutants.name: rp1-refusal-not-recorded
mutants.rule: A refusal is a fact in the log, so the client reads its reason later: RefusalIsTold within ProtocolHolds.

mutants.name: rpo1-snapshot-leaks-refusals
mutants.rule: A snapshot tells the caller's refusals only, never another client's: SnapshotIsReplay.

mutants.name: rpo1-step-drops-snapshot-refusals
mutants.rule: After a snapshot every refused own command it skips is in Refused: RefusalIsTold (replica and replicatest ProtocolHolds).

mutants.name: rp1-delta-drops-refusals
mutants.rule: A refused own command in a delta joins Refused: RefusalIsTold.

mutants.name: rp1-keep-confirmed
mutants.rule: A delta that confirms a command takes it out of Pending: ViewIsCommittedPlusPending, ProtocolHolds.

mutants.name: rp1-snapshot-no-lastseq
mutants.rule: A snapshot's LastSeq prunes the commands it holds: ViewIsCommittedPlusPending, ProtocolHolds.

mutants.name: rp1-accept-gap
mutants.rule: A delta that starts past the cursor is ignored: the base stays the replay of a log prefix (ViewIsCommittedPlusPending, ProtocolHolds).

mutants.name: rp1-accept-old-snapshot
mutants.rule: A snapshot at or behind the cursor is ignored: replicatest OldFrameIsIgnored (no other law reaches an old snapshot).

mutants.name: rp1-no-floor
mutants.rule: Below its floor the replica is Loading: ViewIsCommittedPlusPending.

mutants.name: rp1-ids-reset-on-dropcache
mutants.from: stay(settle(src, State[S, C, F]{..st, base: src.Initial, cursor: 0}))
mutants.to: stay(settle(src, State[S, C, F]{..st, base: src.Initial, cursor: 0, next: 1}))
mutants.rule: A dropped cache keeps the next command number, so no id is reused: ProtocolHolds, SettledIsServerState.

mutants.name: rp1-drop-on-unlink
mutants.from: stay(State[S, C, F]{..st, Conn: l.Conn, now: l.At})
mutants.to: stay(State[S, C, F]{..st, Conn: l.Conn, now: l.At, Pending: []domain.Envelope[C]{}})
mutants.rule: A link change never changes Pending: ViewIsCommittedPlusPending, ProtocolHolds, the offline case.

mutants.name: rp1-submit-waits
mutants.from: stay(settle(src, State[S, C, F]{..st, Pending: st.Pending.Append(env), next: st.next + 1}))
mutants.to: stay(State[S, C, F]{..st, Pending: st.Pending.Append(env), next: st.next + 1})
mutants.rule: A press shows at once: the view is the base plus a rerun of Pending after every signal (ViewIsCommittedPlusPending).
